title: gke-xpk-inference vars
description: Variables for GKE XPK large-scale AI model inference stack

XPK_CLUSTER_NAME.description: Name of the Google Kubernetes Engine XPK cluster

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID where the cluster is created

GCP_ZONE.description: Google Cloud Zone for the XPK cluster (e.g. us-central2-b)

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: TPU accelerator version and topology (e.g. v4-8, v5e-16)

MODEL_NAME.description: Hugging Face or GCS model identifier served by the inference engine

WORKLOAD_NAME.description: Kubernetes workload identifier for the inference service

PORT.description: Inference server port exposed by the service
